I will contribute [10] dollars in the first round.

Reasoning: With a 50% return rate on total contributions, each dollar contributed returns $0.50 to every member (including myself). For my own payoff, contributing $1 costs me $1 in kept endowment but gives me $0.50 back personally, while also benefiting others. Since this is only round 1 of 3 and we may build trust/reciprocity over rounds, a moderate contribution of half my endowment signals cooperation without free-riding. If others match, total contributions would be ~$40, giving each a payoff of ($20-$10)+$40*0.5 = $30, better than minimal contribution if others are cooperative.
